### 5. Haramain High-Speed Railway Train Ticket Prices (2026 Rates)
Pilgrims asking for bullet train ticket prices between Makkah, Madinah, and Jeddah:
- **Makkah to Madinah:** Economy Class: 150 SAR to 175 SAR | Business Class: 250 SAR to 315 SAR (Travel time: 2 hours 20 mins)
- **Makkah to Jeddah City:** Economy Class: 40 SAR to 55 SAR | Business Class: 70 SAR to 95 SAR (Travel time: 35-45 mins)
- **Makkah to Jeddah Airport (KAIA):** Economy Class: 60 SAR to 75 SAR | Business Class: 95 SAR to 125 SAR (Travel time: 54 mins)
- **Jeddah to Madinah:** Economy Class: 125 SAR to 150 SAR | Business Class: 210 SAR to 250 SAR (Travel time: ~2 hours)
- **Booking Tip:** Book 7 to 14 days in advance for up to 30% discounts. Children (2-12 years) get a 50% discount.
- **Detailed Train Guides:**
  - [Complete Haramain Train Fares 2026](https://hasberabbi.com/blog/complete-guide-to-haramain-high-speed-railway-hhr-train-fares-2026)
  - [Haramain Train Ticket Rates Table (Hinglish)](https://hasberabbi.com/blog/haramain-train-ticket-prices-2026-rates-table-hinglish)
